preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 3 <= n <= 100000 for n in [int(line.strip()) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line.split()[0] if c.isdigit())]) or True
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is an integer between 3 and 10^5 inclusive, and the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
Each test case provides exactly n-2 lines, each containing three distinct integers between 1 and n representing the vertices of a triangular piece.
It is guaranteed that a valid solution exists for every test case.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 2 lines per test case, totaling 2t lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) for p in [list(map(int, stdout_lines[2*i].split())) for i in range(t)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first output line contains n distinct integers between 1 and n, representing the vertex permutation p.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(q)) == n - 2 and all(1 <= x <= n - 2 for x in q) for q in [list(map(int, stdout_lines[2*i + 1].split())) for i in range(t)])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the second output line contains n-2 distinct integers between 1 and n-2, representing the cutting order q.

postconditions.expression: all(all({p[i % n], p[(i + 1) % n], p[(i + 2) % n]} == set(pieces[k - 1]) or {p[i % n], p[(i + 1) % n], p[(i + 2) % n]} == set(pieces[k - 1]) for k in q) for i, (p, q, pieces) in enumerate(zip([list(map(int, stdout_lines[2*i].split())) for i in range(t)], [list(map(int, stdout_lines[2*i + 1].split())) for i in range(t)], [input_pieces])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the permutation p and order q are consistent: cutting the pieces in the order specified by q (where q[k] refers to the k-th piece in the input) corresponds to removing triangles formed by three consecutive vertices in the polygon defined by p, such that the remaining shape is always a convex polygon.
